title: Contextual Workspaces
empty-state: No contexts yet. Create one to launch a group of apps together and pin them to workspaces.

auto-reload-hyprland.label: Auto-reload Hyprland
auto-reload-hyprland.description: Run 'hyprctl reload' automatically after saving a context so workspace pins take effect immediately.

hyprland-rules-file.label: Hyprland rules file
hyprland-rules-file.description: Where the generated window-rule include is written. Add 'require("contextual-workspaces")' once to your hyprland.lua, guarded on this file existing.

enable-wallpaper-switch.label: Switch wallpaper with context
enable-wallpaper-switch.description: Apply a context's wallpaper when it is launched, or when live workspace-navigation switching lands on one of its workspaces.

enable-theme-switch.label: Switch color scheme with context
enable-theme-switch.description: Apply a context's color scheme the same way wallpaper switching does. Off by default since it affects the whole shell's palette.

auto-switch-on-workspace-change.label: Auto-switch on workspace navigation
auto-switch-on-workspace-change.description: Apply a context's wallpaper/color scheme when you switch to one of its workspaces manually, not just when you launch it through this plugin.

enable-pomodoro-integration.label: React to Pomodoro Timer
enable-pomodoro-integration.description: Switch to a designated context's wallpaper/color scheme when the Pomodoro Timer plugin (thepunkoff/pomodoro) starts a work or break session.

pomodoro-focus-context-id.label: Focus context ID
pomodoro-focus-context-id.description: Context to switch to when a Pomodoro work session starts. Find a context's ID by editing it in the panel.

pomodoro-break-context-id.label: Break context ID
pomodoro-break-context-id.description: Context to switch to when a Pomodoro break session starts. Find a context's ID by editing it in the panel.
